fallback: Unknown, missing, malformed, wrong event binding or unverified capture -> original fact line only; do not backfill current state.

Do not infer stone material, safety, or garrison. Store enum at emission, not current ring at reading.

templates.captureContract: At undefined -> defined licenceSeasonsLeft emission, inspect after buildings kind=granary, sum nonnegative safe integer inventory.wheat (missing property means engine inventory zero). no_stock iff sum=0 including no granary; stocked iff sum>0. Invalid input unknown. This is inventory at history emission, not a transaction-stage stock and not proof any purchase or income occurred.

Same/future/inconsistent tick unknown. Absence means no prior in-game rumour record, not ignorance or lack of preparation.

variants.headline: 앞서 열병 소문이 들어온 뒤, 역병이 도시에 도착했다.

templates.captureContract: Only second undefined -> defined AND first.endTick defined <= after.tick. after.curacy must exist. filled iff filledTick defined <= after.tick; vacant iff filledTick absent or > after.tick. Malformed dates unknown. This classifies appointment state only, not presence of a church building or named living priest. Same-tick curacy transitions use after and imply no ordering within tick.
